metadata.name: Godavari River Floodplain (Bhadrachalam Basin)
metadata.region: Godavari River Basin, Bhadrachalam & Polavaram Inundation Corridor
metadata.description: Wide alluvial river floodplain experiencing severe monsoon inundation. SAR flood depth maps differentiate ambulance-passable channels (<0.3m) from deep motorboat channels (>0.5m), while high river bunds and temple mounds provide SAR-verified dry staging points for tethered drone pseudolites.
metadata.sar_source: EOS-04 C-band SAR + HAND Depth (Bhoonidhi NRSC, Jul 2025)
metadata.benchmark_reference: Chimata et al. (NRSC/ISRO, Jul 2025, NHESS) - SAR + HAND Depth RMSE 0.805m

dry_ridges.name: Bhadrachalam Temple Mound Embankment
dry_ridges.description: Historically elevated temple mound embankment standing 18.5m above the 100-year peak flood level, central to all rescue sectors.

dry_ridges.name: Kunavaram North Flood Bund
dry_ridges.description: Reinforced irrigation embankment providing unblocked coverage over northern submerged farmland and isolated hamlets.

dry_ridges.name: South Polder High Bund
dry_ridges.description: Southern staging bund with direct road link to regional evacuation camps.
